title: Lauren — Christmas Planner Mom Overwhelm V2
duration_rule: EDIT VIDEO AROUND HUMAN SPEECH. Never speed speech. Natural pauses are mandatory. Shot clocks are budgets, not stretchers.

style.look: photoreal UGC / documentary phone footage in a real home

prefer: speaker starts → cut to Lauren reaction
lip_sync_strategy.on_camera_speech: Lauren only, shots 4 and 6–7, small natural mouth motion allowed; do not sacrifice face lock for sync

provider_choice: Higgsfield Kling 3.0 Pro I2V is the already-integrated photoreal identity path from Lauren v1; Seedance/WAN are cheaper 480p and weaker at locking this family, so we keep Kling with sound=off.

video_defaults.rate_basis: Live Lauren v1 Higgsfield estimate 2026-09-21 ($0.28 / 4.480 credits per 5s). 10s assumed 2× until live /estimate at generate time.

characters.identity_lock: Keep Lauren the same woman: mid-30s mother, warm fair skin, light freckles, brown-green eyes, messy honey-brown high bun with loose wisps, cream oversized knit cardigan, white tank, gold necklace. Keep the same daughter in white snowflake pajamas with teddy, same son in dark green Christmas pajamas, same husband in a dark grey henley, same golden retriever, same warm Christmas kitchen. Photoreal. Do not redesign faces.

reference_assets.note: Start frame already has a small smile. Use as the curious beat. Do not bloom into joy.

reference_assets.usage: optional B-roll if shot 7 needs husband in frame; not in base paid-video count

shots.camera: wide table; subtle handheld; daughter begins speaking then hold on Lauren's face while the line finishes off-camera
shots.lip_sync: daughter starts on-camera if mouth is already open, then L-cut; do not require sync

dialogue.speaker: daughter
dialogue.text: Mom! Mom!... Did you get my present yet?

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock: same Lauren, daughter, son, husband, golden retriever, Christmas kitchen. Subtle handheld. Daughter leans in and starts to speak, then camera holds on Lauren's overloaded reaction. Kids shift naturally. Tree lights twinkle. No invented text, no extra people, no orbit, no lip-sync performance, no morphing.

shots.camera: same table, lists in fg; son partly off-camera; overlapping speech
shots.lip_sync: son off-camera / side; Lauren may murmur without sync

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock. Messy real household. Son tugs for attention. Lauren stays at the laptop, overwhelmed. Husband stays in the background with tiny natural motion. Subtle handheld. No readable new text. No extra people. No dramatic zoom.

shots.camera: stay primarily on Lauren; husband in background/side; his line plays while we watch her
shots.lip_sync: husband off-camera or side-profile; do not close-up-sync him

dialogue.speaker: husband
dialogue.text: Babe... what are we doing for Christmas dinner?

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock. Camera stays on Lauren. Husband shifts slightly in the background with the mug. Lauren's eyes flick to him then back to the laptop. Tiny head shake. No close-up of the husband. No extra people. No orbit.

shots.lip_sync: Lauren may have the clearest on-camera line; small mouth motion ok; if sync fails, keep the tired face and lay VO

dialogue.speaker: lauren
dialogue.text: I can't keep up with all of this.

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock on Lauren. Very slow push-in. She breathes, blinks, genuine exhaustion, not crying, not melodramatic. Tiny mouth motion only if natural. Hold still after. No extra people. No invented text. No aggressive camera.

shots.camera: Lauren looks at phone; kids present but quiet; phone screen must stay unreadable in the model output
shots.expression: exhausted → curious, not instantly happy. Still already has a small smile — do not escalate.

copy: Girl, use the planner I sent you 😭
Seriously. It saved my Christmas last year.

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock. Lauren looks at the phone. Expression stays tired-curious. Do not widen into a happy grin. Phone screen stays blank/blurred — no readable text, no UI, no logos. Subtle handheld. Kids breathe. No extra people.

shots.camera: Lauren at the real laptop; UI is composited, never generated
shots.lip_sync: short reactions; UI portion is screen capture so mouth sync is irrelevant
shots.ui_rule: Show 2–3 real check-offs before her emotional state changes. Solution must not feel instant.

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock. Lauren looks at the laptop. Small 'wait' recognition, then exploring, not a sales smile. Laptop screen may stay dark/blank for compositing. Subtle handheld. Family presence stays soft. No readable invented UI. No extra people.

shots.camera: cut into cookie scene; natural kitchen; husband may join via alt still in assembly if needed
shots.lip_sync: daughter off-camera or side; Lauren looks at her then answers

video.prompt: Photoreal 9:16 UGC from this exact still. Identity lock. Family decorating cookies. Small laugh. Natural hand motion placing sprinkles. Soft kitchen life. No narration energy. No extra people. No orbit. No morphing faces.

audio.room: same house, slightly different mic distance per speaker
audio.why: Already used on Lauren v1; ElevenLabs is not wired. Voices generated as separate files so audio-only regen is possible.

voices.style: American woman ~30–38, warm, tired then quietly relieved, understated
American man ~30–42, casual, from across the room
natural young girl, not cartoon, not polished commercial

assets.source: original synth bed like v1, no licensed track, quiet after shot 4 then slight lift on payoff

ui_overlays.method: 9:16 screen recordings / screenshots composited in ffmpeg. Insert cuts over shot 6, not warped fake laptop UI. Include 2–3 real check-offs.
